summary.zh: 查看错误、性能与发布记录
summary.en: Inspect errors, performance traces, and releases

description.zh: 查询项目的错误事件、堆栈、性能追踪与发布版本。适合线上报错后拉取上下文、确认影响范围。首次连接在浏览器登录 Sentry 并选择组织授权。
description.en: Query error events, stack traces, performance traces, and releases for your projects. Useful for pulling context after a production error and checking impact. Sign in to Sentry and pick an organization on first connect.

authHint.zh: 首次连接在浏览器登录 Sentry 并授权
authHint.en: Sign in to Sentry and authorize on first connect
